# Close proof PRs 1-99

Candidate: `origin/close-final-candidate` `a63c4c733523294450f605e73de3306edff81e58`

Rule, and no other close rule: for each PR head fetched as `origin pull/N/head`, `mb=$(git merge-base origin/close-final-candidate FETCH_HEAD)` and files are `git diff --name-only $mb FETCH_HEAD` (two-dot, not three-dot). Close only when that list is empty, or every file has the same blob token on the PR head and on `origin/close-final-candidate` (`git rev-parse`, token `MISSING` if absent). Any differing file is unique work and stays open. A closed PR with any differing file is reopened. No bundle-commit mention, no tests, no CI, no merge. #237 was not touched. No branch was deleted.

Heads used: `refs/proof/pr-N`, created by `git fetch origin pull/N/head:refs/proof/pr-N`. That ref is the PR head `FETCH_HEAD` would name. Tokens for the close decision were checked with `git rev-parse`: every file on the MATCH PR, and at least one differing file on every UNIQUE PR. Bulk token maps used `git ls-tree -r` object ids, which are the same ids `git rev-parse <rev>:<path>` returns.
